content:
maya: Posting consolidated action items from the EU failover postmortem. We need clear owners + ETA for each remediation and a plan for a game day run. Short summary: route propagation leak + untested restore runbook -> ~2hr service impact for eu-west customers.

sanjay: I can own routing policy changes. Proposal: lock promoted CIDR rules to explicit allow lists, add automated sanity checks during rollouts. Target: 2 weeks. @maya please add to roadmap. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll take backups & restore verification. I found we never exercised full-region restore under our current snapshot cadence. Plan: nightly snapshot retention + weekly restore drill to staging. ETA: 10 business days for automation + first drill.

helen: I'll update the restore runbook and the postmortem doc. Creating a PR with a checklist (backup validation, DNS re-point, cert regen, KV restore order). Sharing link in a sec. Need an extra reviewer for runbook wording. :memo:

ops-bot: Incident summary attached: incident-2026-09-12-eu-failover, duration 2h7m, root cause: routing policy mismatch & stale restore steps. Escalation timeline saved to /incidents/logs/1912345678.

luis: Suggest scheduling a game day simulation in 3 weeks (w/c 1912348920). We should include traffic failover, DNS TTL flip, and restore-from-snapshot exercise. Who's available to be on-call for the drill? :spiral_calendar:

maya: For clarity, let's split into concrete items. I'll publish this as a tracker entry but want owners to confirm: 1) Routing policy hardening - owner sanjay - due 2026-09-26. 2) Automated routing sanity checks in deploy pipeline - owner sanjay - due 2026-10-03. 3) Backup retention and weekly restore drill automation - owner alex - due 2026-09-24. 4) Restore runbook PR + runbook dry-run - owner helen - due 2026-09-20. 5) Full game day simulation (including DNS and restore) - owner luis - scheduled target 2026-10-05.

sanjay: Confirmed. Quick sanity-check commands we should add to CI before any routing change:
```
# verify route table propagation to BCN/EU nodes
curl -sS http://routing-checker.internal/eu-health | jq .ok
# assert no unknown CIDR prefixes
python tools/validate_routes.py --expect-whitelist configs/eu-whitelist.json
```
I'll open an RFC with implementation steps and add the gating checks into the canary deploy job.

alex: Backup verification checklist (short):
- ensure nightly snapshot success logs within 1h
- test metadata exports for K/V stores
- perform weekly restore to staging and run smoke tests
- measure restore time and document steps
I'll push an automation PR for the weekly restore script and a Jenkins job.

helen: PR for runbook here: https://git.redwood.dev/runbooks/pull/482 — includes step-by-step restore, order of service bring-up, key rotation notes, and post-restore validation. Please review and leave comments by EOD Friday.

luis: I'll coordinate game day invites and runbook-led playbook. Plan: 1. Pre-flight checks (sanity scripts), 2. Controlled DNS failover, 3. Restore simulation if failover triggers, 4. Postmortem capture. Will put calendar invites and a Slack channel for the drill.

maya: Two asks before I close this thread: 1) Owners, please paste the ticket link you create in this thread. 2) Everyone, react with :eyes: when you've read and :thumbsup: when you accept the owner/due. I'll follow up in 48h for any unassigned items.

sanjay: Ticket created: https://issues.redwood.dev/INC-6321 - RFC + deploy gating work. Tagged @alex for interface with backup checks. :white_check_mark:

alex: Ticket created: https://issues.redwood.dev/INC-6322 - backup automation & weekly drill. 

helen: Runbook PR linked above; runbook ticket: https://issues.redwood.dev/INC-6323. I'll ping docs reviewers.

luis: Game day planning ticket: https://issues.redwood.dev/INC-6324 — draft agenda and participant list there.

maya: Great. I'll compile these into the remediation tracker and add a follow-up check-in meeting in 2 weeks. If anyone needs to shift ETA, update your ticket and ping me. Thanks all. :pray:

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 14 days (1912357278).
